definitions.explanation: the time frame during which exams are held at schools and universities

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}{期間|きかん}に{入|はい}った。
{試験|しけん}{期間|きかん}は{図書館|としょかん}が{混|こ}む。
examples.english: The library gets crowded during exam periods.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}{期間|きかん}{中|ちゅう}はアルバイトを{休|やす}む。
examples.english: I take a break from my part-time job during the exam period.

notes:
{試験|しけん}{期間|きかん} is a compound of {試験|しけん} (exam) + {期間|きかん} (period). Refers to the designated time frame when exams are held at schools and universities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {試験|しけん}{期間|きかん}に{入|はい}る: to enter the exam period
- {試験|しけん}{期間|きかん}{中|ちゅう}: during the exam period
- {試験|しけん}{期間|きかん}が{終|お}わる: for the exam period to end

JAPANESE ACADEMIC CALENDAR:
Japanese universities typically have two main exam periods:
- {前期|ぜんき}{試験|しけん}: first semester exams (July-August)
- {後期|こうき}{試験|しけん}: second semester exams (January-February)

RELATED TERMS:
- {定期|ていき}{試験|しけん}: regular scheduled exams
- {中間|ちゅうかん}{試験|しけん}: midterm exams
- {期末|きまつ}{試験|しけん}: final exams
- {追試|ついし}: makeup exam
